<thought>Based on the exact mass (224.120 Da) the molecular formula is C₁₆H₁₆O. This corresponds to a benzophenone core (DBE = 9) with a propyl substituent on one phenyl ring, i.e., 4‑propyl‑benzophenone. The SMILES for this structure is “O=C(c1ccccc1)c2ccc(cc2)CCC”.</thought>
<final_answer>O=C(c1ccccc1)c2ccc(cc2)CCC</final_answer>
